summary: New York, New York, software developer, self-taught programmer, proficient in Haskell, Erlang, Go, Node.js, and Verilog, prefers command-line tools (Vim, tmux), advocates for open-source software, critical of proprietary software, enjoys functional programming, has a wife, prefers cooking at home over dining out, has been using Linux full-time since 2013, interested in decentralized systems, supports public access to research funded by tax dollars, skeptical of cloud services, has a strong interest in programming languages and their paradigms, actively engages in discussions about technology ethics and sustainability.
